description: Production architecture specs for upgrading the ProvenanceShield framework into a hardware-attested, non-military, confidentiality-isolated boundary system.

primary: Refactor Rust enclave modules into an production-grade hardware validation sandbox
Implement multi-provider TEE attestation (AMD SEV-SNP, Intel TDX, AWS Nitro)
Bind sealed-key release directly to silicon measurement states and ECHR compliance metrics
Deploy a provenance-locked CI/CD build pipeline to generate static code measurements
Establish a tamper-evident forensic log chain using sequential cryptographic hashing
Finalize the Python data layer with structure-preserving manifold cognition operators
secondary: Enforce deterministic runtime refusal in unauthorized cloud environments
Isolate all high-risk telemetry parsing within encrypted memory boundaries
Eliminate unverified third-party compiler dependencies from the attestation pipeline
Verify that all forensic outputs carry immutable RFC 3161 timestamp assertions
